data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'balanos' meaning 'mighty' and 'muthos' meaning 'protector'. Balmuth was a name given to strong and courageous leaders who protected their people. The name Balmuth carries the meaning “Protector of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balmuth usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balmuth total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
